channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Noah Hendricks identified by Calera PD as suspect in fatal shooting
item.description: The Calera Police Department has identified Noah Reed Hendricks as the suspect arrested in connection with a fatal shooting on Thursday, Feb. 12.

item.title: Thompson, Chelsea, Briarwood, Oak Mountain make North-South teams for volleyball, cross-country
item.description: Thompson’s Maddy Henderson, Brielle Merriweather and Judy Green, Chelsea’s Alexis Rudolph and Briarwood’s Julie Roberts made the volleyball North-South All-Star Game while Oak Mountain’s Zack Joyce and Briarwood’s Allie Hale will be in the cross-country meet.

item.title: Montevallo baseball preview: young Bulldogs searching for identity in 2026
item.description: The Montevallo Bulldogs took a step back in 2025, finishing 8-13 and narrowly missing out on postseason play after reaching the playoffs the year prior.

item.title: Defending champions Vincent embrace youth movement
item.description: Vincent is preparing for life as the defending champion with a largely new cast of characters, relying on strong pitching, rising leaders and lessons learned from last year’s run to continue their recent run of success.

item.title: UM Board of Trustees approves elimination of 16 minors, concentrations
item.description: The UM Board of Trustees approved the elimination of 16 minors and concentrations in order to address an ongoing financial shortfall.

item.title: UM postpones vote to cut 4 athletic programs following outcry from student-athletes
item.description: The UM Board of Trustees postponed voting on whether to cut tennis and swimming programs from its slate of offerings following feedback from students.

item.title: Briarwood blasts Demopolis in 5A sub-regional
item.description: The postseason opener at Briarwood looked a lot like the Lions’ area championship performance earlier in the week — relentless defense, unselfish offense and seniors determined to extend their season.

item.title: Calera finishes strong to beat McAdory, reach first Sweet 16 since 2018
item.description: The Calera Eagles flipped a switch down the stretch, turning a two-possession game into an 18-point win over McAdory in sub-regionals to reach the Sweet 16 for the first time since 2018.

item.title: Pelham hold off Northridge to advance to Sweet 16
item.description: Pelham outdueled Northridge on the road behind 42 combined points from Tee King and Ally Barfield to book a trip to the Sweet 16.

item.title: Suffocating defense powers Chelsea to sub-regional win over Paul Bryant
item.description: The Chelsea Hornets emerged victorious in sub-regionals with a dominating win over the Paul Bryant Stampede.
